title: Claude Duet is beautiful. I still forgot to use it
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (16 mins) | 🎙️ I tested Claude Duet, Anthropic's beautifully designed new personal agent, on real work to see if it can beat my personal agent fatigue and make the cut
summary: Anthropic's new personal agent, Claude Duet, lives on your phone, inherits all your Claude plugins and connectors, and is pitched at small business owners and busy professionals. It's the most polished agent launch I've seen: thoughtful onboarding, task lists, first-class artifacts, and Slack-style channels.
takeaways: I put it to work on my inbox and Slack, my sales pipeline, a Google Docs sales deck, a launch video, and finding Warriors tickets for my kids, and I'll walk you through what it nails, where it stalls, and what Anthropic needs to fix before it can become anyone's number one agent.
It's the most polished agent launch I've seen: thoughtful onboarding, task lists, first-class artifacts, and Slack-style channels.
But polish isn't enough when you're competing with every other personal agent for attention.
